_documentation.model_purpose: Empirical D1×D2×D3 signal discrimination rules for the 11 METAR stations. V3: 7-condition concordance replaces deterministic thresholds.
_documentation.source: Timing store cross-analysis, population: SP500 daily bars 2011-2026
_documentation.methodology: V3 Concordance: 7 independent bearish votes classify signal quality. C1: RR<0.8 (43.6pp spread), C2: HR75<50% (34.1pp), C3: PF<1.0 (31.8pp), C4: SGS<-0.05 (14.3pp), C5: ceil_hr>0.60 dual_nature (63.3pp), C6: MFE<|MAE| (29.0pp), C7: pvalue>0.80 (17.5pp). Classification: 0/7=STRUCTURAL HIGH, 1/7=STRUCTURAL/MODERATE, 2/7=MODERATE/NOISE, 3-4/7=NOISE/PULLBACK, 5/7=TRAP MODERATE, 6-7/7=TRAP HIGH.

signal_classes.STRUCTURAL_FLOOR: Concordance 0-1/7 bearish — multi-scale convergent, real capitulation (median HR75=71.4%)
signal_classes.MODERATE_FLOOR: Concordance 1-2/7 bearish — probable floor with caveats (median HR75=57.7%)
signal_classes.PULLBACK: Concordance 2-3/7 — tactical bounce, ambiguous direction (median HR75=50.0%)
signal_classes.TRAP: Concordance 5-7/7 bearish — false floor, distribution disguised (median HR75=25.0%)
signal_classes.NOISE: Concordance 3-4/7 — insufficient conviction either way (median HR75=50.0%)
signal_classes.ACCUMULATION_STRUCTURAL: Complacent zone: floor_hr>70%, ceil_hr<30% — institutional buying (N=135, floor_hr=100%)
signal_classes.DISTRIBUTION_FORMING: Complacent zone: ceil_hr>70%, floor_hr<30% — institutional selling (N=23, ceil_hr=100%)
signal_classes.UPLEG: Neutral zone: floor_hr > ceil_hr + 15% — continuation upward (N=338)
signal_classes.DOWNLEG: Neutral zone: ceil_hr > floor_hr + 5% — continuation downward (N=50)

confidence_tiers.HIGH: Strong concordance agreement (0/7 or 6-7/7) + multi-scale STRUCTURAL pattern
confidence_tiers.MODERATE: Clear concordance majority (1/7 or 5/7) or D2 velocity confirms direction
confidence_tiers.LOW: Borderline concordance (2-4/7) or scale pattern is FLAT
confidence_tiers.INSUFFICIENT: No timing data available — fallback to this JSON
